label: God as divine being versus divine person
term: God as divine being versus divine person
resolution: Every quantified God in the Q11 proof is an original IsGod instance in Being: a hypothetical divine being, not Father, Son or Spirit as distinct persons. suppositumOf is used here for the individuating basis in the anti-plurality argument and not as a divine-person index. The common deity parameter does not identify persons. Existing IsGod is not redefined and no Trinitarian conclusion follows.
